auditable_statuses.neural_accepted: proposal + polish passes independent forward replay and physical acceptance gates
auditable_statuses.classical_fallback: failed neural proposal, missing checkpoint, or rejected replay triggers fallback with remaining compute budget; retains both attempts
auditable_statuses.rejected: out-of-distribution or exhausted budget terminates fail-closed

limitations: Synthetic fixtures and software contracts only
No fabricated native training acceleration or physical certification
Confidence metric records empirical domain coverage, not human golfer truth probability
